title: SHEIN Black Friday 2026: when it starts, what is live now (11.11) and how the 4CW5Y code works

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Black Friday 2026 falls on November 27. In early November, SHEIN focuses promotions on its 11.11 sale before rolling out official Black Friday campaign pages; historically, major Black Friday deals launch after 11.11 and run through month-end. 4CW5Y is a referral code: you search for it in the search bar of the SHEIN app, with no fixed discount promised.

contentSections.heading: When SHEIN's Black Friday starts
paragraphs: In early November, SHEIN is running its 11.11 promotion and has not published Black Friday dates or a page for 2026. Black Friday on the calendar is the last Friday of the month, and the phases and dates vary with your country's SHEIN site. SHEIN combines 11.11 and Black Friday into a single campaign, with phases that raise the maximum discount until the end of the month. The table below is the yardstick: what SHEIN announced in the last three years.

comparisonTable.caption: Phases and maximum discounts announced by SHEIN, by the press that published the announcements and by the brand's profiles. The "up to" applies to some items.
rows: up to 80% at the start, up to 85% the week before and up to 90% on Black Friday and the Saturday after, with 48 hours of free shipping in Black Friday week
11.11: up to 85% at the start, 90% the week before and 95% on the days of 11.11. Black Friday: up to 90%, rising to 95% in the last five days of the month
up to 90% on more than 800,000 items in the first phase, with free shipping in several categories; in Black Friday week, up to 95% on more than 800,000 items

postParagraphs: In 2026, 11.11 falls on a Wednesday and Black Friday on a Friday. If SHEIN repeats the pattern, the Black Friday deals will come after 11.11 and run to the end of the month. This is an estimate based on past years, and this guide is updated when SHEIN announces the 2026 campaign.

In all three years, the maximum discount went up near the end. That does not mean the item you want gets cheaper: compare the final price and stock, and if you need a hard-to-find size, don't wait for the last phase.

contentSections.heading: "Up to 90%" is not the whole cart

image.alt: Cecília Mauad in two looks from a SHEIN haul: a light blouse tied at the waist with a black midi skirt, and a long black dress with light cut-outs

paragraphs: The campaign percentage is the biggest discount on some items. Most of the catalog has smaller discounts, and the price of each item changes across the phases. To avoid falling for the big number in the ad:
bullets: Save the items to your wishlist before the campaign starts and note today's price.
Compare the wishlist price with the later phases: in the last three years, the maximum discount went up in the final stretch.
Look at the final price in the cart, with shipping and taxes, and not only the percentage in the announcement.
If the item comes in a hard-to-find size, don't wait for the last phase: stock may run out first.

contentSections.heading: Coupons, points and the 4CW5Y code
paragraphs: Under SHEIN's coupon policy, one platform coupon applies per order. Each coupon has an expiry date, and one not used in time becomes unavailable.
SHEIN points are worth US$ 1 per 100 points and take up to 30% off the product value, not counting shipping and taxes.

4CW5Y is not a coupon: it is Cecília's SHEIN referral code. You search for 4CW5Y in the SHEIN app and check the conditions shown for your account. SHEIN campaigns change all the time: check the current ones on the store page here on the site before placing your order.

contentSections.heading: Exchanges and returns after Black Friday
bullets: **Deadline:** up to 20 days after you receive it, even if you simply did not like the piece. That is the window SHEIN publishes; the policy of your country's SHEIN site, shown on your order page, is the one that applies.

**Items that can only be returned within 7 days:** bodysuits, swimwear, underwear, earrings and piercings, and pet products, plus cosmetics, party items and craft items with the seal broken. These can only be returned within the 7-day withdrawal period, counted from delivery.
**Coupon:** on a partial return, the coupon counts as used and is not given back; if the order falls below the minimum, the difference comes out of the refund.
**Tax:** the import tax paid is not refunded once the order has shipped.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: When does SHEIN's Black Friday start and how long does it last? Black Friday 2026 falls on the last Friday of November, the 27th. SHEIN is in its 11.11 sale now and has not announced the campaign. Going by past years, the Black Friday deals come after 11.11 and run to the end of the month; phases change every year and by country site.
How long does SHEIN's Black Friday last? In 2024 and 2025, until the end of November. In 2023, until the Saturday after Black Friday. The 2026 one has no end date yet.
What is SHEIN's 11.11? It is the Singles' Day sale, on the 11th day of the 11th month. SHEIN combines 11.11 and Black Friday into a single campaign, with discount phases until the end of the month.
Can I use more than one coupon on SHEIN? One SHEIN coupon per order.
Is 4CW5Y a discount coupon? No. It is Cecília's SHEIN referral code: you search for the code in the SHEIN app and see the conditions for your account.
Is there free shipping on SHEIN's Black Friday? Free shipping changes with each phase of the campaign: check yours in the cart before paying.

How long do I have to return what I bought on Black Friday? Up to 20 days after you receive it, under SHEIN's published terms (check the policy of your country's SHEIN site on your order page). Underwear, swimwear, bodysuits, earrings and a few other items can only be returned within 7 days.
